data.title: 玛夏 · 暖炉初雪的怀抱温存
data.action: 跪坐在软绵绵的羊毛地毯上，双手温柔地拍了拍身旁的空位，金褐大波浪卷发垂落胸前，眼眸盈满宠溺的母性柔光，浅浅微笑着发出邀请。
data.location: 欧式典雅卧室，壁炉中木柴哔剥燃烧，双层玻璃窗外雪花纷飞
data.lighting: 壁炉跃动的金红炭火与暖白顶灯交融，室内满溢着驱散严冬的烘暖橙光
data.camera: front view, high angle, medium shot
data.mood: 极致包容的年上姐姐温暖，安心、绵软而充满深切依恋
data.description: 欧式典雅卧室，壁炉中木柴哔剥燃烧，双层玻璃窗外雪花纷飞。跪坐在软绵绵的羊毛地毯上，双手温柔地拍了拍身旁的空位，金褐大波浪卷发垂落胸前，眼眸盈满宠溺的母性柔光，浅浅微笑着发出邀请。 她微微抬眸轻语——“今天在学校也很努力了呢~来，小政近，把头靠在玛夏姐姐的怀里，好好休息一下吧。”
data.promptProse: Kneeling comfortably on a plush white sheepskin rug before a crackling stone fireplace on a snowy winter night, Masha wears a flowing mist-blue double-layered chiffon nightgown with a deep ruffled V-neckline. Gently patting the soft rug beside her with an affectionate, warmly welcoming smile, she gazes up toward the viewer as golden firelight fills the cozy bedroom against snowflakes drifting past the dark window.
data.animaCaption: Kneeling on the white sheepskin rug before the crackling fireplace in her mist-blue ruffled chiffon nightgown, Masha gently pats the space beside her with a warm, inviting smile. Golden firelight glows across the room while snow drifts outside the dark window.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a soft mist-blue double-layered chiffon nightgown with a deep-V ruffled neckline, empire waist, and flowing floor-length hem showing her bare shoulders and cleavage.
